title: Handwritten observation notes with sketch of horizon band arc at sunset
description: Page of handwritten notes in ink with a single drawn arc stroke beside the note "Sunset - broad band in atmosphere - est 60° arc" and color words such as yellow-orange, blue, black. Other notes mention dark adaptation, zodiacal light, solar corona, and a haze layer described as a band "6 to 8° above the horizon" and "about 2° wide". The page is predominantly text.
